name: A woven tapestry: wool weft with silk highlights, beaten down over a cotton warp so the weft alone shows (weft-faced); the image woven in

diffuseAlbedo.note: The reflectance a photograph of the weave's white stands for: a first value, until a tapestry's wool is measured. The dyes' colours, faded as they are, are in the photograph itself.

refractiveIndex.note: The wool and silk of the weft lie near the same index.

porosity.note: A weave's void share between its yarns and fibres; no measurement was read.

wettingDepth.note: A tapestry is a single weave: water reaches all of it.
